scripts.generate: cd site && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run quartz plugin install
scripts.sync: git subtree pull --prefix=site https://github.com/jackyzha0/quartz.git v5 --squash && cd site && pnpm install && pnpm run quartz plugin install --from-config
scripts.dev: cd site && pnpm run quartz build -d ../raw --serve
scripts.build: cd site && pnpm run quartz build -d ../raw
scripts.preview: echo site link: http://127.0.0.1:8080 && echo build path: site/public/ && python -u -m http.server 8080 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory site/public
scripts.plugins:install: cd site && pnpm run quartz plugin install
scripts.plugins:sync: cd site && pnpm run quartz plugin install --from-config
